'''Jaller''' was a [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Mantellian Separatist]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], as well as the [[Separatist War]] between [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], which was backing the [[Ord Mantell Central Authority|government of Ord Mantell]]. She resided in [[Oradam village]] with her husband, [[Zak (Separatist)|Zak]]. They were eventually poisoned by a [[ZR-57 orbital strike bomb|bomb's]] radiation, the same powerful bomb the Separatists had stolen from the Republic. She and her husband traveled to [[Fort Garnik]] to ask for supplies but the Republic troopers refused giving any assistance, ignoring the intel Zak wanted to exchange. Eventually a Republic [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|sergeant]] found the wounded couple and agreed to exchange medical supplies for Zak's information. Zak agreed, but Jaller tried to convince him not to.

==Behind the scenes==
Jaller first appeared in [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively-multiplayer role playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
